'D8' is a selectable entry in the Routing combo ("D-infinity (recommended)", "D8") and `panel.routing` maps it to 'd8' (return "d8" if "D8" in self._routing_combo.currentText() else "dinf"), which baseline.py:427 hands to the worker and analysis_worker.py:147 passes to `FlowAnalysis.run`. Two clicks from the UI to the AttributeError above.
